title: FLXIBLE CORPORATION: STRUCTURE:DOOR ASSEMBLY (487 affected)
summary: THE EMERGENCY RELEASE VALVE MOVES OUT OF POSITION CAUSING IT TO BECOME INOPERATIVE. WHEN THIS HAPPENS, THE ENTRANCE DOOR CANNOT BE OPENED BY ACTIVATING THE EMERGENCY RELEASE HANDLE.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT (227 affected)
summary: A VEHICLE THAT IS FULLY EQUIPPED AND LOADED WITH A TYPICAL PAYLOAD WILL CAUSE AN OVERLOADED CONDITION ON THE FRONT AXLE.

title: CENTURY PRODUCTS: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT (146,895 affected)
summary: THE RED RELEASE BUTTON CAN ROTATE UPWARD IN A CRASH OR SUDDEN STOP, MAKING IT POSSIBLE FOR THE BUCKLE TO RELEASE THE SHOULDER HARNESS.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT (25,000 affected)
summary: THE ECCENTRIC CAM ADJUSTER BOLTS IN BOTH FRONT LOWER SUSPENSION ARM-TO-FRONT AXLE BRACKET ATTACHMENTS MAY FAIL DUE TO ASSEMBLY MISALIGNMENT.

title: COBRA INDUSTRIES, INC.: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:TRAILER HITCHES AND ATTACHM (24 affected)
summary: THE MOUNTING BRACKET FOR THE REAR TRAILER HITCH DOES NOT HAVE SUFFICIENT STRENGTH TO WITHSTAND THE LOADS OF AN ATTACHED TRAILER.

title: STEWART & STEVENSON SERV.: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT (15 affected)
summary: DURING EXTREME BRAKING APPLICATION THE FRONT AXLE ROLLS FORWARD, PUSHING THE STEERING ARM FORWARD, AND NON-UNIFORM BRAKING EFFORT, CAUSED BY VARIOUS BRAKE COMPONENT CONDITIONS, RESULTS IN THE VEHICLE PULLING TO THE RIGHT.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): POWER TRAIN:DRIVELINE (INDICATOR FORWARD OR REVERS (2,700 affected)
summary: A CONDITION EXISTS THAT ALLOWS OIL TO LEAK FROM THE ALL WHEEL DRIVE TRANSFER CASE. LOW OIL LEVELS IN THE TRANSFER CASE CAN CAUSE BEARING DAMAGE AND FAILURE.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): STRUCTURE:HATCHBACK ASSEMBLY (80,000 affected)
summary: GREASE APPLIED TO THE LIFTGATE LATCH RUBBER BUMPERS TO EASE COMPONENT ASSEMBLY CAUSED THE BUMPER TO SWELL, INTERFERING WITH THE MOVEMENT OF THE LIFTGATE LATCH PAWL. THIS PREVENTS THE LIFTGATE LATCHING WHEN CLOSED AND DIFFICULT TO OPEN WHEN LATCHED.

title: IC CORPORATION: STRUCTURE:BODY:GRAB BAR:STRAP MOUNTING ASSIST (46,500 affected)
summary: PASSENGERS CLOTHING CAN UNKNOWINGLY BECOME CAUGHT IN THE HANDRAILS AT BUS DOORS WHEN EXITING THE BUS.

title: MASTER BRAKE SYSTEMS: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC SYSTEM (637 affected)
summary: SYNCHRONIZING VALVES AND KITS FOR VALVES LEAK BRAKE FLUID DUE TO: 1. THE VALVE O-RING WAS CUT OR MARRED DURING ASSEMBLY; 2. IMPROPERLY COMPOUNDED O-RINGS AND KITS THAT ARE INCOMPATIBLE WITH THE BRAKE FLUID AND CAUSING FAILURES WERE INSTALLED IN THE VALVE ASSEMBLY.

title: Ford Motor Company: STRUCTURE:HATCHBACK SUPPORT ROD (ALSO 13640000) (3,700 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES.  THE LOWER PIVOT PIN THAT JOINS THE LIFTGATE GAS STRUT TO THE BODY CAN SEPARATE FROM THE LOWER STRUT MOUNTING BRACKET DUE TO AN UNDERSIZED RIVET HEAD.

title: CARPENTER INDUSTRIES, INC.: STRUCTURE:BODY:GRAB BAR:STRAP MOUNTING ASSIST (8,950 affected)
summary: PASSENGERS CLOTHING CAN UNKNOWINGLY BECOME CAUGHT IN THE HANDRAILS AT BUS DOORS WHEN EXITING THE BUS.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): FUEL:FUEL SYSTEMS (920,583 affected)
summary: IF THE PLASTIC COATING OF THE FUEL FILLER AND/OR BREATHER PIPE IS DAMAGED, SALT WATER MAY ACCUMULATE BETWEEN THE PLASTIC COATING AND THE STEEL PIPES, AND THE ACCUMULATION COULD CAUSE CORROSION WHICH WOULD EVENTUALLY RUST THROUGH THE AFFECTED PIPES, ALLOWING GASOLINE FUMES AND FUEL TO LEAK.

title: Ford Motor Company: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:IGNITION:ANTI-THEFT (91,000 affected)
summary: THE ROLL PINS SECURING THE IGNITION LOCK IN THE STEERING COLUMN HOUSING CAN SEPARATE OR MOVE OUT OF POSITION.

title: HIGH COUNTRY ALUMINUM PRODUCTS. LLC: VISUAL SYSTEMS:WINDSHIELD WIPER/WASHER SWITCH (571 affected)
summary: THE WINDSHIELD WIPER/WASHER SWITCH ON THE DASH IS NOT ILLUMINATED, AND DOES NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 101, "CONTROLS AND DISPLAYS."

title: HIGH COUNTRY ALUMINUM PRODUCTS. LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN (571 affected)
summary: AN INCORRECT DIAMETER WASHER MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED ON SOME SAFETY BELT ASSEMBLY FLOOR ANCHORAGES. THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 210, "SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY ANCHORAGES."

title: HIGH COUNTRY ALUMINUM PRODUCTS. LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN (571 affected)
summary: SAFETY BELTS MAY BE INCORRECTLY ROUTED BECAUSE A PASSAGE HOLE THROUGH THE SEAT WAS NOT PROVIDED, AND THERE MAY BE EXCESSIVE SLACK IN THE SAFETY BELT, WHICH DOES NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 209, "SAFETY BELT ASSEMBLIES."

title: Gulf Stream Coach, Inc.: EQUIPMENT:ELECTRIC EQUIPMENT:RADIO:TAPE DECK ETC. (167 affected)
summary: THE WIRE USED TO POWER THE ELECTRONIC MEMORY ON A RADIO INSTALLED IN THE REAR OF THE MOTORHOME WAS INCORRECTLY ROUTED DIRECTLY TO THE HOT SIDE OF THE BATTERY DISCONNECT SOLENOID, AND HAS NO FUSE PROTECTION.

title: STEWART & STEVENSON SERV.: STEERING:LINKAGES (15 affected)
summary: THE FRONT AXLE ASSEMBLY MOUNTING WELDS ARE INADEQUATE AND ARE CRACKING. THIS CONDITION CAN EFFECT THE CENTER RADIAL ARM WHICH IS USED FOR CASTER ADJUSTMENT AND AXLE ROLL.

title: Oshkosh Corporation: STRUCTURE:FIFTH WHEEL ASSEMBLY (201 affected)
summary: THE CROSSHEAD KING PIN FORGINGS OF THE UPPER COUPLING ASSEMBLY CAN CRACK, CHIP, OR BREAK OFF. THIS CAN CAUSE COUPLER SEPARATION.

title: FLEETWOOD ENTERPRISES, INC.: VISUAL SYSTEMS:WINDSHIELD WIPER AND WASHER (74 affected)
summary: THE WINDSHIELD WIPER SYSTEM HARDWARE WAS INCORRECTLY MOUNTED, CAUSING WIPER BLADE OVERTRAVEL AND PREMATURE WEAR, AND IN EXTREME CASES, THE WIPER BLADES MAY FAIL TO CORRECTLY TRAVEL OVER THE WINDSHIELD.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN (45,958 affected)
summary: THE REAR OUTSIDE SEATING POSITION SAFETY BELTS MAY LOCK UP AT ANGLES OTHER THAN THOSE REQUIRED BY FMVSS 209, "SEAT BELT ASSEMBLIES".   THIS DOES NOT CONFORM TO THE MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:CAP:FILLER (54 affected)
summary: WHEN THE FUEL TANKS WERE TESTED IN ACCORDANCE WITH FEDERAL MOTOR CARRIER SAFETY REGULATION 363.67, FUEL TANK CAPS AND/OR FILLER NECK WELDS LEAKED.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: BRAKES:SPRING BRAKE CHAMBER (CAN) (200 affected)
summary: THE SPRING BRAKE CHAMBERS MOUNTED ON TAG AXLES WITH MOUNTING STUDS ALIGNED HORIZONTALLY INSTEAD OF VERTICALLY CAN RESULT IN FRACTURE OF THE BRAKE CHAMBER HOUSING BASE WHICH LIMITS THE APPLICATION OF SERVICE BRAKES ON THE AFFECTED WHEEL.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS (160 affected)
summary: THE EXHAUST PORT IN THE UP POSITION ALLOWS WATER TO ENTER THE AIR BRAKE SYSTEM, WHICH CAN BLOCK THE AIR BRAKE SYSTEM IN FREEZING CONDITIONS.

title: Ford Motor Company: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:SHOCK ABSORBER (25,000 affected)
summary: THE REAR SHOCK CROSSMEMBER OF THE FRAME CAN CRACK AND SEPARATE FROM THE FRAME.

title: Midwest Industries, Inc.: SUSPENSION:I-BEAM:SOLID:FRONT (9,600 affected)
summary: THE COTTER KEY THAT LOCKS THE HEX SLOTTED NUT ON THE AXLE SPINDLE IS MISSING.

title: FAIRMONT TAMPER: STEERING:WHEEL AND COLUMN (2,419 affected)
summary: KEYS ATTACHED TO THE KEY RING OF AN IGNITION KEY WHILE IT IS IN THE VEHICLE IGNITION CAN BECOME LODGED IN THE STEERING LOCK RECEIVER AS THE STEERING WHEEL IS BEING TURNED.

title: FLEETWOOD ENTERPRISES, INC.: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES (128 affected)
summary: THESE VEHICLES WERE MANUFACTURED WITH INSUFFICIENT SUPPORT STRUCTURE FOR THE MAIN DOOR ENTRY STEP. THE STEP CAN BREAK LOOSE FROM ITS ATTACHMENT TO THE VEHICLE.

title: Subaru of America, Inc.: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:PIPE:FILLER:NECK (3,351 affected)
summary: THE FUEL FILLER SYSTEM DOES NOT COMPLY WITH THE LEAKAGE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 301, "FUEL SYSTEM INTEGRITY".

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:POWER ASSIST:VACUUM SYSTEM (14,300 affected)
summary: DURING THE REMOVAL AND INSTALLATION OF THE AIR FILTER HOUSING WHILE SERVICING THE VEHICLE, IT IS POSSIBLE TO MISROUTE THE PREFORMED VACUUM HOSE AND DAMAGE THE CHECK VALVE IN THE VACUUM HOSE. IF THE CHECK VALVE IS DAMAGED, LOSS OF SUFFICIENT BRAKE POWER ASSIST WILL OCCUR.

title: Volvo Car USA, LLC: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL (1,864 affected)
summary: PLASTIC HOOD INSULATION CLIP(S) WAS(WERE) INADVERTENTLY DROPPED INTO THE HOSE BETWEEN THE CHARGE AIR COOLER AND THE THROTTLE HOUSING WHICH CAN INTERFERE WITH THE THROTTLE OPERATION.

title: FLEETWOOD ENTERPRISES, INC.: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL (359 affected)
summary: WHILE OPERATING THE ENGINE IN REVERSE GEAR, ENGINE TORQUE CAUSES THE ENGINE TO ROLL, CAUSING THE THROTTLE MODULATOR CABLE ASSEMBLY TO CONTACT THE FLOOR AND BIND THE THROTTLE CABLE HOLDING THE THROTTLE IN AN OPEN POSITION.
